brief: A clear tenancy-evidence review symbol: an upright pale-ivory RENTAL AGREEMENT folio whose top edge is clipped by a bold dark-plum HOUSE-shaped paperclip/roof. On the folio are three short recessed clause lines and a muted rose vertical chronological rail with three large evidence nodes. A small rose inspection lens integrates into the lower edge, visibly inspecting the last clause. House/document/evidence review must read as one balanced icon, not a judge or a real-estate-sales logo. Plum #3C283B, pale lavender ivory #E3D7E9, muted rose #BE8E9C. No gavel, key, scales, court seal, writing, numbers or approval tick. Strong broad forms; lens subordinate to the rental dossier.
